messages:
ana_marketing: Kickoff — tiny hackpack: 1-page reference app + 20m tutorial video + short benchmark narrative + 1hr webinar. Goal: launch next Wed 14:00 PT. Need owners for demo, bench, landing, ops, and social. Focus: low-friction dev onboarding for the refapp and clear perf/cost story.

jay_devrel: I can own the tutorial + live demo. Proposal: simple chat-summarizer refapp that shows embeddings + streaming. Keep demo code <200 LOC so people can fork quickly.

sam_engineer: I’ll run the microbench. Plan: two workloads — short chat (<=512 tokens) and long context (>=4096). Need a 300-prompt sample set. Will produce p50/p95 latency and cost-per-1k tokens.

maria_growth: I’ll do landing + registration funnel. Routing: Webinar signups -> HubSpot list "Tiny Hackpack - Webinar" -> SFDC lead mapping by region. Use utm_campaign=tiny-hackpack for all promo links.

kevin_prod: Add recommended runtime config to README: batch_size=16, kv_cache_enabled=true, quant=4bit. Also adding a quick curl snippet for try-it-now in the hero.

ana_marketing: oops typo — meant ana_marketing: Re: benchmarks & narrative — I’ll draft the benchmark blog outline (why the numbers matter for cost vs latency tradeoffs). Jay, can you also add a 1-slide arch diagram and a 10-step demo script?

content-bot: Reminder: content calendar slot booked Wed 14:00. Drafts due Mon EOD. Preview site: https://tiny-hackpack-preview.redwood.dev (internal).

jay_devrel: Demo script draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/demo-script (placeholder). Demo run command: `./run.sh --model open-x --port 8080`. Plan: 10m live demo, 10m Q&A. Need an ops buddy in the room to monitor GPU usage.

sam_engineer: First bench run posted to the sheet: short-chat p50=45ms p95=180ms, long-context p50=210ms p95=650ms. Cost estimates attached in sheet. I’ll also export a small csv of prompts + responses for the blog samples.

maria_growth: Landing copy ready in Figma. Two CTAs: [Try in Browser] and [Register Webinar]. I'll wire form to HubSpot webhook -> Zapier fallback -> SFDC. Example hidden field: `source=tiny_hackpack_webinar`. Social schedule draft: email + X + Dev Forum posts Thu AM.

kevin_prod: Pushed README update with curl snippet and quick troubleshooting. Snippet: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"open-x","prompt":"Summarize...","max_tokens":128}'
``` Note: we call out GPU OOM mitigation (reduce batch_size / enable kv cache).

ana_marketing: again — ana_marketing: :thumbsup: Love the momentum. Final launch checklist (owners): 1) refapp repo + tutorial — Jay; 2) benchmark blog + narrative — Sam + me; 3) landing + registration + social — Maria; 4) webinar ops runbook — Kevin; 5) promo assets — Maria + Jay. Targets: publish Wed 14:00 PT, social blast Thu 09:00 PT.

ana_marketing: final note — please drop any links to assets, preview URLs, or recording notes into the shared thread before Tue EOD. If anyone has blockers speak now so we can reassign.
